topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I turned the pages, each one a brushstroke on the canvas of our life, vivid and more intricate than the last. It was me, in every line, in every turn of phrase. The way I laugh, the curve of my smile, the secrets I hold close—there, on the page, captured with a depth I never knew I carried. Each chapter unfolded like a secret shared, a memory cherished, a moment frozen in time. To see myself through their eyes, rendered with such care, such tenderness—it was as if they had woven the very essence of who I am into a tapestry so vibrant, it could only ever be a work of love.
